arxiv-1912-09555.description: Abstract Making a payment in a privacy-aware payment channel network is achieved by trying several payment paths until one succeeds. With a large network, such as the Lightning Network, a completion of a single payment can take up to several minutes.

arxiv-2206-13272.title: Wideband Audio Waveform Evaluation Networks: Efficient, Accurate Estimation of Speech Qualities
arxiv-2206-13272.creator: Andrew A. Catellier 1, and Stephen D. Voran 1
arxiv-2206-13272.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Andrew A. Catellier 1, and Stephen D. Voran 1. Speech quality and speech intelligibility can vary dramatically across the wide range of currently available telecommunications systems, devices, and operating environments. This creates a strong demand for efficient real-time measurements of quality and intelligibility. Wideband Audio Waveform Evaluation Networks (WAWEnets) are convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that operate directly on wideband audio waveforms in order to produce evaluations of those waveforms.

arxiv-2206-14646.title: Superradiance of non-interacting atoms
arxiv-2206-14646.creator: M. Bojer, J. von Zanthier
arxiv-2206-14646.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Bojer, J. von Zanthier. Fully-excited two-level atoms separated by less than the transition wavelength cooperatively emit light in a short burst, a phenomenon called superradiance by R. The burst is characterized by a maximum intensity scaling with the square of the number of atoms N N and a temporal width reduced by N N compared to the single atom spontaneous decay time.

arxiv-2301-04205.description: Abstract . Performance verification is a nascent but promising tool for understanding the performance and limitations of heuristics under realistic assumptions. Bespoke performance verification tools have already demonstrated their value in settings like congestion control and packet scheduling. In this paper, we aim to emphasize the broad applicability and utility of performance verification.

arxiv-2401-06752.title: Stylometry Analysis of Multi-authored Documents for Authorship and Author Style Change Detection
arxiv-2401-06752.creator: Muhammad Tayyab Zamir, Muhammad Asif Ayub, Asma Gul, Nasir Ahmad, Kashif Ahmad
arxiv-2401-06752.description: Abstract In recent years, the increasing use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)–based text generation tools has posed new challenges in document provenance, authentication, and authorship detection. However, advancements in stylometry have provided opportunities for automatic authorship and author change detection in multi-authored documents using style analysis techniques.

arxiv-2402-07657.title: Exploring light deflection and black hole shadows in Rastall theory with plasma effects
arxiv-2402-07657.creator: Riasat Ali, Xia Tiecheng, Rimsha Babar, Ali Övgün
arxiv-2402-07657.description: Abstract In this article, we examine the gravitational deflection of particles in curved spacetime immersed in perfect fluid in the context of Rastall theory. We propose an infinite region approach to Gibbons-Werner to avoid singularity, given that the integral region is generally infinite. In the Rastall theory framework, the black hole solutions in the dust field are studied.

arxiv-2502-10083.title: Entangling power of Anti-Jaynes-Cummings model and its efficiency to encode information in atomic system
arxiv-2502-10083.creator: M. Kh. Ismail, T. M. El-Shahat, N. Metwally, A.-S. F. Obada
arxiv-2502-10083.description: Abstract Entangling power is crucial for quantum information processing. This study examines the Anti-Jaynes-Cummings Model (AJCM) in generating quantum correlations between two atoms interacting via the Ising model and its effect on the entangled system. The AJCM is shown to create entanglement suitable as a quantum channel for information encoding.

arxiv-2505-13702.title: Unsupervised anomaly detection in MeV ultrafast electron diffraction
arxiv-2505-13702.creator: Mariana A. Fazio, Salvador Sosa Güitron, Marcus Babzien, Mikhail Fedurin, Junjie Li, Mark Palmer, Sandra S. Biedron, Manel Martinez-Ramon
arxiv-2505-13702.description: Abstract Abstract I Introduction MeV ultrafast electron diffraction (MUED) is a pump-probe characterization technique for studying ultrafast processes in materials. The use of relativistic beams leads to decreased space-charge effects compared to typical ultrafast electron diffraction experiments employing energies in the keV range Wang et al. 2003 ; Zhu et al. 2015 .

arxiv-2509-19487.title: The evolution of velocity dispersion in the Sco-Cen OB association
arxiv-2509-19487.creator: Josefa E. Großschedl, João Alves, Sebastian Ratzenböck, Núria Miret-Roig, Alvaro Hacar, Sebastian Hutschenreuter, Laura Posch
arxiv-2509-19487.description: Abstract We study how stellar velocity dispersion within the Scorpius-Centaurus OB association (Sco-Cen) has evolved over approximately 20 million years, from its formation to the present day. Using data from the Gaia mission along with supplementary stellar radial velocities, we identified a surprising sequence of abrupt jumps and intervening plateaus in the velocity dispersion correlating with star formation bursts.

pmc-10644825.title: Rapid Diagnosis of Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis Triggered by Disseminated BCG Infection in Infants With Severe Combined Immunodeficiency: Case Report
pmc-10644825.creator: Ting-Ting Zou, Qiong Liao, Yang Liu, Qin Guo, Yu Zhu, Chao-min Wan

pmc-10724244.description: Summary A standard unsupervised analysis is to cluster observations into discrete groups using a dissimilarity measure, such as Euclidean distance. pmc-11403940.title: Complete mitochondrial genome and phylogenetic analysis of Dollfustrema vaneyi (Trematoda: Bucephalidae)
pmc-11403940.creator: Ye Hu, Tong Ye, Hong Zou, Gui-Tang Wang, Wen-Xiang Li, Dong Zhang
pmc-11403940.description: BackgroundThe Bucephalidae is a large family of digenean trematodes but most previous analyses of its phylogenetic position have relied on a single mitochondrial gene or morphological features. Mitochondrial genomes (mitogenomes) remain unavailable for the entire family. To address this, we sequenced the complete mitogenome of Dollfustrema vaneyi and analyzed the phylogenetic relationships with other trematodes.

pmc-11657891.description: Maintaining optimal fluid balance is crucial for patients with end-stage renal disease on dialysis, as both fluid overload and excess removal can lead to poor outcomes. pmc-12571707.title: 十例原发性肝神经内分泌肿瘤的诊治及文献复习
pmc-12571707.creator: 寅 江, 钰迪 孟, 世威 张, 咏涛 王, 春年 汪, 才德 陆
pmc-12571707.description: 回顾性分析10例原发性肝神经内分泌肿瘤患者的临床资料。其中男性8例，女性2例，中位年龄63岁。所有患者均无类癌综合征表现，健康体检时发现3例，表现为无痛性黄疸2例，以腹部胀痛为主诉5例（其中1例合并黄疸）。实验室检查发现，10例患者中神经元特异性烯醇化酶升高1例，糖类抗原19-9升高4例，甲胎蛋白升高2例。10例患者均行手术治疗，手术方式包括肝切除术、肝门部胆管癌根治术，并根据肿瘤侵犯程度联合施行肝右动脉切除重建术、肝转移瘤切除术、胰十二指肠切除术等。10例患者术前均未诊断神经内分泌肿瘤，术后病理学检查结果提示神经内分泌瘤G2 5例，神经内分泌瘤G3 1例，神经内分泌癌4例。随访10~73个月，结果4例患者死亡，6例存活。本文资料显示原发性肝神经内分泌肿瘤诊断主要依靠排除肝外病灶后的病理学检查，根治性手术为目前首选治疗方法。 神经内分泌肿瘤是一类起源于神经内分泌细胞的肿瘤，近年发病率呈上升趋势，肝脏为常见的转移器官，但原发于肝脏的神经内分泌肿瘤即PHNEN非常少见［1］。由于神经内分泌肿瘤通常缺乏独特的肿瘤形态，当源于其他器官的神经内分泌肿瘤转移至肝脏时，缺乏追溯其起源的手段，故PHNEN的诊断和治疗存在诸多难点［2-3］。本文回顾性分析了2012—2024年宁波市医疗机构收治的10例PHNEN患者的临床资料，总结患者的诊疗过程和预后以供临床参考，现报道如下。 对象与方法 对 象 检索宁波市临床病理诊断中心数据库2012年8月至2024年6月收集的10例PHNEN患者的资料，并进一步在宁波市医疗中心李惠利医院（5例）、宁波大学附属第一医院（3例）和中国科学院大学宁波华美医院（2例）收集患者的临床资料。纳入标准：①患者经多学科专家会诊后行手术治疗，术后病理学检查提示PHNEN；②术前或术后通过胃肠镜检查以及增强CT、MRI和（或）PET-CT检查排除转移性神经内分泌肿瘤；③术后随访半年以上未发现肝脏外原发病灶。 诊断方法 根据2019年版WHO消化系统肿瘤分类中神经内分泌肿瘤的分类和分级标准［4］，结合患者既往史、临床症状、实验室检查、影像学检查、术后病理学检查和随访情况进行诊断。 治疗方法 患者在静脉-吸入复合全身麻醉下接受开腹手术或腹腔镜手术。手术方式包括肝切除术、肝门部胆管癌根治术，并根据肿瘤侵犯程度合并施行肝右动脉切除重建术、肝转移瘤切除术、胰十二指肠切除术等。患者术后接受个体化辅助化疗。 术后并发症诊断标准 腹腔感染：患者术后3 d出现畏寒、高热、腹胀、肠麻痹等症状并持续24 h以上，血常规提示白细胞计数升高，影像学提示腹腔内液体积聚，引流液或穿刺液培养出细菌或真菌。术后胰瘘：患者术后3 d及以上任意量的引流液中淀粉酶浓度高于正常血清淀粉酶浓度上限3倍以上，同时出现相应临床表现。根据严重程度，术后胰瘘分为A（生化漏）、B、C三级［5］。死亡：患者术后住院期间死亡或出院30 d内死亡。 结 果 人口学资料和临床表现 10例患者中男性8例，女性2例，年龄范围31~89岁，中位年龄为63岁，体力状况评分为0~2分，术前肝功能Child-Pugh分级均为A级。1例患者乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性，3例患者合并高血压。见表1。 表110例原发性肝神经内分泌肿瘤患者的基线情况Table 1Baseline conditions of the 10 patients with primary hepatic neuroendocrine neoplasms例 序性 别年龄（岁）基础疾病Child-Pugh分级主 诉1男67高血压A体检发现肝占位10 d2男56无A腹痛10 d3男31无A无痛性黄疸8个月4男64无A腹痛、黄疸伴消瘦5个月5男64无A无痛性黄疸2周6女59无A上腹部疼痛2个月7女63高血压、乙肝A右上腹胀1个月8男89高血压A体检发现肝占位2周9男33无A体检发现肝肿物1个月10男63无A腹胀1个月例 序 体力状 况评分 病灶部位 肿瘤最大径 （cm） 肿瘤标志物10左肝6.0无异常20右肝3.5无异常31肝门2.3CA19-9：171.4 U/mL41肝门伴S4转移瘤3.2CA19-9：1983.0 U/mL51肝门3.5CA19-9：142.9 U/mL60左肝2.0无异常70右肝10.0AFP：10.4 ng/mL；CA19-9>1909 U/mL82左肝1.6AFP：26.14 ng/mL；CEA：7.97 ng/mL90左肝2.0无异常100左肝23.0NSE：51.13 ng/mLCA：糖类抗原；AFP：甲胎蛋白；CEA：癌胚抗原；NSE：神经元特异性烯醇化酶.

pmc-12683211.title: Advances in Conductive Nanomaterials for Cardiac Arrhythmia and Future Directions in Bioevaluation Strategies
pmc-12683211.creator: Sumithra Y. Srinivasan, Anna Laromaine
pmc-12683211.description: Cardiac arrhythmia (CA), characterized by irregular heart rhythms, affects nearly 90% of individuals with cardiovascular diseases. Commonly triggered by myocardial infarction (MI) or ion channel dysfunctions, CA is traditionally treated using pacemakers, cardioversion, ablation, and anti‐arrhythmic drugs. Recently, emerging strategies like cardiac patches and injectable formulations with conductive nanomaterials (CNMs) have shown promise in restoring cardiac rhythm post‐MI.

pmc-13224499.title: Inflammasomes in glioblastoma
pmc-13224499.creator: Vaidya Govindarajan, Quinn Jackson, Christian K Ramsoomair, Manuela Aramburu, Juan Pablo de Rivero Vaccari, Robert W Keane, Ashish H Shah
pmc-13224499.description: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most common primary malignancy of the brain with a poor prognosis. Despite advances in therapeutics, the gold standard of treatment remains maximal safe resection followed by temozolomide and radiation therapy, with the inter- and intratumoral heterogeneity of GBM making effective management challenging. As a result, the search for mechanisms underlying this heterogeneity has been paramount.

pmc-13389703.title: Fourteen-year bridge to cure in occult ectopic ACTH syndrome: resection of a 3-mm pulmonary carcinoid
pmc-13389703.creator: Nobuyuki Koriyama, Takahiko Obo, Kazuma Ogiso, Mitsuharu Nomoto, Koichi Sakasegawa, Yoshihiko Nishio
pmc-13389703.description: Ectopic adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) syndrome (EAS) often involves occult microtumors, making localization challenging. We report a 68-year-old woman with severe ACTH-dependent hypercortisolism in whom the primary tumor remained occult despite extensive imaging, including 68Ga-tetraazacyclododecanetetraacetic acid-D-Phe(1)-Tyr(3)-octreotide positron emission tomography/computed tomography. Based on a positive octreotide challenge test, she received long-acting release octreotide for over a decade, achieving sustained biochemical stability.
